mission: REFACTOR (not KEEP, not RETIRE) the synthesis pipeline based on Tier-4 confirmatory evidence

root_causes.cause: generic synthesis prompt licenses rewriting, applied uniformly to code
root_causes.evidence: SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_TEMPLATE wording, unchanged for non-coding, replaced for coding

root_causes.cause: no agreement detection before invoking synthesis
root_causes.evidence: bf06: byte-identical candidates still went through a real LLM rewrite that fabricated a bug
cs09: dropped class definition is syntactically valid, invisible to ast.parse alone

root_causes.cause: self-edit framing has 2 real call sites, both legitimate, not currently leaking
root_causes.evidence: grep confirmed CODE_OUTPUT_RULES used only in self_edit_manager.py; risk is future misuse, not a live bug

river_deliberation.py: select_best_fallback_candidate() (prefers syntactically valid candidates over longest)
structured logging to memory/synthesis_integrity_log.jsonl (hash+preview, not full text)
code_verification.py: _FENCE_RE gained re.IGNORECASE (real pre-existing bug found during live validation, also benefits verify_response_code())
self_edit_manager.py: guard comments on CODE_OUTPUT_RULES and generate_code_from_plan() citing Tier-4 evidence, zero behavior change
changes.blast_radius: gated to task_type == 'coding' only; non-coding synthesis byte-for-byte unaffected, confirmed by regression test

historical_failure_replay.bf06: detect_full_agreement() fires, zero synthesis calls made, correct code returned
historical_failure_replay.cs09: find_missing_agreed_definitions() fires, falls back to a candidate containing the required class

honest_scope_limits.test3: general unsupported-operation detection only proven for the full-agreement case, not internal-logic mutation within an agreed structure
honest_scope_limits.test5: syntactic-validity preference only, not execution/test-based preference (no general oracle exists for arbitrary conversational coding questions)

runs.finding: raw-text ast.parse bug: every synthesis with leading prose looked empty
case-sensitive fence regex bug: capitalized 'Python' fence never matched
clean, zero false positives in this sample

runs.note: sample too small/easy to show a pass-rate delta; validation's real value was catching the 2 bugs above, not measuring effect size

live_validation.self_edit_live_regression: not run (source-level checks only); deliberate scope decision given self-edit's real production side effects

results_summary.bf06_class_failures: eliminated by construction (no synthesis call occurs on full agreement)
results_summary.cs09_class_failures: caught and corrected via fallback, not prevented at generation

remaining_risks: no general semantic/operation-level diff -- only definition-name-level completeness is checked
no true execution-based evidence ranking for arbitrary conversational coding questions (no external oracle exists outside experimental harnesses)
logging deliberately stores hash+preview not full text, which slowed real-bug diagnosis and required targeted full-capture diagnostics
small validation sample (5 tasks, 1 session, 1 council composition, 1 pinned model)
fallback selection has no oracle either -- can be wrong in ways this refactor cannot detect
self-edit's own live generation path not re-exercised end-to-end in this pass

next_experiment.design: fresh, disjoint, hash-frozen 20-30 task suite, run twice under identical real conditions (refactor active vs. mechanisms patched to no-op), paired McNemar comparison
next_experiment.primary_endpoint: paired pass-rate comparison on identical tasks across the two conditions
next_experiment.secondary_endpoint: real full_agreement_shortcut / completeness_fallback trigger rates at a larger, more diverse scale
